snippets.text: So, I heard you like short, easy to
understand, and straight to the point
guide. Here is the fastest and most
efficient way to reach level 45 as
Asmodian explained in under 4 minutes.
Recently, I have done a leveling speed
run with Ranger on Taiwan servers, and I
have reached level 45 in 3 hours and 50
minutes. You can find the link to the
full uncut video in the description. The
leveling consists of following yellow
main story quests while only doing 13
different regional green side quests.
The reason why you will need to do some
side quest is because to proceed with
the main story, you need to complete the
Ascension quest two times, and to fill
up the Ascension gauge to 100% you will
need to do five side quests two times
during leveling. Start by following
yellow main story quest from level one
all the way until you reach level 12,
where you will also pick up and complete
the first green side quest. At level 14,
after completing the first stronghold as
part of your main story, take the second
green side quest but do not deliver it.
Continue with the main story until you
get to level 17 and unlock the level 18
story quest. Then go back, deliver the
side quest, and accept the new one that
pops up. Teleport to the main quest area
and accept the two side quest that
appear in that area. Continue with the
main quest until you reach level 20 and
unlock a new part of the story. Then go
back and complete the three side quest
you picked up before. After that,
continue with the main story quest and
at level 22, after completing the story
quest, you will unlock second Ascension
quest as your Ascension gauge will be
100%. Complete it and carry on with the
main story quest until level 27, then
also grab a side quest that appears in
the camp. Complete it and deliver it,
then carry on with the main story until
the level 31 when you unlock a level 32
story quest. In the main city there will
be a two-part side quest. Complete it
and then teleport to the healing spring.
>> [music]
>> Pick up and complete the side quest
there. Then teleport to the abandoned
site. Pick up and complete the side
quest there as well. At level 32 after
completing the main story your third
ascension quest will appear because your
gauge fills up to 100%. Complete the
ascension quest and carry on with only
main story. At level 33 in Grave Robber
Campsite you will also want to complete
the Finders Keepers side quest. Shortly
after in the same camp, Traveling
Merchant
and at level 42 in Kumrika Seller, Herb
Pouch Heist side quest. The reason for
that is because these three quests are
on your way as you do your main story
and waste zero time. With these side
quests you will be able to reach level
45 before the final main story boss
fight. Now let me give you some tips.
Before leveling you will want to make
sure you key bind your macro key to
whatever you like and set up your macro
as soon as you unlock all of your
skills. Having macro while leveling
makes every boss fight easier.
Whenever you are moving from quest to
quest always use a wing flying trick to
travel faster and then not waste flight
power. You don't need to enhance your
gear but you can if you get stuck. It
won't give you much power and you will
be replaced anyways. Prioritize leveling
up your most important damage dealing
skills first and always replace the
better gear item when you get it from
the quest. It's indicated by this green
arrow that you have something better in
your inventory. If you don't want to do
these side quests you can do sealed
dungeons but the main reason why I do
side quests is because you get
accessories as a reward which you don't
get from the main story quest.
And accessories will increase your power
significantly, making bosses and mobs
easier to kill. Grab all the feathers
that are in your way or close to the
area where you are, but do not go out of
your way to grab them. And also, don't
forget about your stigma skills. After
you unlock at the ascension, every time
you level up, you get one stigma point.
So, always make sure you are leveling
them up and using the best ones that you
can. And that's going to be it. Since I
helped you level up to 45, consider
helping me out by interacting with this
video, subscribing, and leaving a like.
If you're interested in more content,
check out videos appearing on your
screen.
